products.desc:
## Product Overview

The Satlab SAL32 Automatic Level is an optical surveying instrument designed for determining differences in elevation between points. Automatic levels use an internal compensator to establish a horizontal line of sight after the instrument has been approximately levelled, allowing surveyors and construction teams to take staff readings for levelling operations. Common applications include transferring benchmarks, checking formation and foundation levels, road and drainage works, earthwork control and general construction setting-out. APSL lists the SAL32 in its Levelling Instruments category and publishes a product price on its website. The public product information reviewed does not provide a complete optical specification table. products.name: HydroBeam M4 Multi-Beam Echo Sounder
products.short: The HydroBeam M4 Multi-Beam Echo Sounder is listed by APSL for hydrographic surveying and marine measurement work. A multibeam echo sounder emits multiple acoustic beams across a swath beneath a survey vessel, collecting depth measurements over a wider area than a single-beam system. Designed for marine, inland-water and hydrographic survey operations.
products.desc:
## Product Overview

The HydroBeam M4 Multi-Beam Echo Sounder is listed by APSL for hydrographic surveying and marine measurement work. A multibeam echo sounder emits multiple acoustic beams across a swath beneath a survey vessel, collecting depth measurements over a wider area than a single-beam system. When combined with accurate positioning, heading, motion and sound-velocity information, the measurements can be processed into bathymetric point clouds, depth grids and seabed models. APSL identifies applications including pipeline surveys, dredging, hydrographic surveys, underwater archaeology, harbour surveys, reservoir-storage surveys, environmental research and rescue or salvage operations. These use cases require careful system integration and survey planning. The public APSL listing does not provide a complete technical specification table for beam count, frequency, swath angle, depth range, ping rate, accuracy, motion-sensor integration or data formats. Those details must be verified against the current HydroBeam M4 datasheet and the exact package offered.
